decision_problem: Only descriptors available; predict release retrospectively or under mild generalization
representative_works: Bannigan 2023; PLGA two-stage ML 2026; CMPB review 2025
main_strength: Simple; strong on small tabular data; easy benchmark communication
main_gap: No explicit mechanism latent; weak on one-to-many ambiguity; weak UQ

decision_problem: Given formulation plus a few early release points, forecast the rest
typical_algorithms: tabular ML with early points; direct regressors; mechanism-routed forecasters
representative_works: Bannigan 2023; audited PLGA core in this repo
main_strength: Closest to deployment reality; strongest current release-forecast task
main_gap: Externally still mostly direct regression; weak shared object design

decision_problem: Summarize dense curves into kinetic parameters, clusters, or assay-specific release groups
typical_inputs: release curves; assay metadata; sometimes formulation descriptors
typical_outputs: kinetic parameters; cluster labels; IVR test design summaries
representative_works: Digital Discovery liposome workflow 2025; computational pharmaceutics review 2021
main_strength: Strong mechanism discipline and assay relevance
main_gap: Usually not sparse-prefix forecasting; limited UQ and shared posterior objects
relevance_to_us: Best source of non-PLGA discipline and intake design

decision_problem: Use simulators plus ML to accelerate formulation design rather than only retrospective prediction
typical_inputs: formulation descriptors; simulator outputs; PBPK/PD; MD; assay targets
typical_outputs: optimized formulations; downstream exposure or release estimates
typical_algorithms: TabPFN and other ML models embedded in simulator loop
main_gap: Not yet a shared partially observed release benchmark
relevance_to_us: Dangerous adjacent system if it becomes release-forecast-native

decision_problem: Choose next experiment or formulation to reach target release behavior efficiently
typical_inputs: design space; sparse assay feedback; objective functions
typical_outputs: next experiment; next formulation; optimized release behavior
representative_works: Hydrogel active learning JCR 2026; ADDR optimization review 2025
main_strength: High workflow value; real lab acceleration potential
main_gap: Often does not model full release uncertainty-aware trajectories across mechanisms
relevance_to_us: Important future flank; borrow decision-support loop

decision_problem: Make the field benchmarkable and reusable
typical_inputs: literature corpora; metadata standards; web interfaces
typical_outputs: datasets; schemas; web platforms; interoperable workflows
main_strength: Wins adoption and interoperability; shapes field defaults
main_gap: Usually not the strongest predictive science by itself
